summary: Web-only frontend test of the newly added admin surfaces (Verify accounts, Blog approvals, Reset PINs). All 7 requested flows pass end-to-end against the shared backend. Super-admin gating, tab navigation with active-state highlighting, sidebar/Settings entry points, and non-admin redirects to / all behave as specified. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminBlogs uses window.confirm() for the Deny action — matches mobile parity but a themed AlertDialog would be more consistent with the rest of the shadcn UI. Not blocking.

AdminVerify and AdminResetPins share nearly identical search/list scaffolding (debounced GET /admin/users, empty-state, avatar row) — consider extracting an <AdminUserList/> component to reduce duplication. Not blocking.
test_credentials: Founder semidiepie@gmail.com / Semi123! (unchanged). Test user test_blogreq25@example.com / TestPass123! created via /api/auth/register (auto-purged on restart).
seed_data_creation: Registered test_blogreq25 and submitted POST /api/blogs/request-permission as that user to populate the blog-approvals queue; the Deny action then removed it during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 25 verified: (1) super-admin sidebar-admin link → /admin/verify; (2) AdminTabs highlight active tab (bg-primary class) and route between /admin/verify, /admin/blogs, /admin/reset-pins; (3) Verify toggle POST /admin/users/{id}/verify flips label Verify↔Verified in-place; (4) AdminBlogs Deny (POST /admin/blogs/revoke/{uid}) removes the row and confirm() dialog is handled — Grant path not explicitly exercised but shares the same act() code path; (5) AdminResetPins Set/Change/Remove PIN dialog works and badge (PIN set / No PIN) updates; (6) Settings admin card links (settings-admin-verify/blogs/reset-pins) route correctly; (7) Non-super-admin: no sidebar-admin, no Settings admin card, and /admin/verify /admin/blogs /admin/reset-pins all redirect to /. Founder password was NOT changed.
